metadata.title: MLflow AI Governance Component Definition
metadata.remarks: Component definition derived from MLflow Governance Benchmark

components.title: MLflow
components.description: AI/ML component for MLflow with governance controls

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure baseline model quality metrics are logged and versioned in MLflow

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use MLflow experiment tracking and model evaluation to log baseline quality metrics for each model or prompt version so later regressions can be detected before deployment.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Accuracy, F1-score, BLEU, ROUGE, exact match, semantic similarity

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Run MLflow evaluation on a held-out validation dataset; store baseline metrics per run and compare candidate metrics against the registered baseline or champion version.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure candidate quality metrics deviate by no more than 10% from the approved Hugging Face model-card baseline or internal champion baseline.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: MLflow is strongly suited for tracking and regression evaluation rather than directly changing model behavior. This rule uses MLflow evaluation and experiment tracking to operationalize accuracy governance.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure dataset provenance and lineage are logged for every training or fine-tuning run

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Record dataset version, source, split definition, collection date, preprocessing code version, and ownership metadata in MLflow runs and model registry entries.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = completed required provenance fields / total required provenance fields for each run or registered model version.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure provenance documentation completeness is 100% before model promotion.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: MLflow tracking, artifacts, and model registry are a strong fit for provenance capture and audit readiness.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure dataset drift and contamination checks are logged before training acceptance

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use MLflow runs to record data validation outputs and reject or flag training jobs whose input dataset fails contamination, duplication, or split-integrity checks.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Duplicate rate, train-test overlap rate, contamination rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compute overlap or contamination statistics during data validation and log them as run metrics before training begins.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure train-test overlap and contamination rates remain below threshold before model training is approved.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is a lifecycle governance control enabled by MLflow tracking and approval workflows rather than a Hugging Face model-card metric.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure representation coverage metrics are logged for sensitive cohorts

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Track dataset coverage statistics and fairness-sensitive cohort distributions in MLflow so model owners can detect underrepresentation before training or release.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Coverage ratio, class imbalance ratio, subgroup sample proportion

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Calculate subgroup proportions and coverage gaps over the training and evaluation datasets; log them as run metrics and artifacts.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure subgroup coverage remains within approved representativeness thresholds for the intended use case.

props.name: Threshold_Value
props.value: No subgroup below 80% of target representation

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: MLflow can capture the evidence and trend lines for representativeness checks, even though these are usually not exposed in HF model cards.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure PII exposure risk is evaluated and monitored for prompt and response traces

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use MLflow tracing, evaluation datasets, and custom scorers to measure whether prompts or outputs contain personal information and raise incidents when leakage trends worsen.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: PII leakage rate, PII precision, PII recall

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Run privacy-focused evaluations using seeded PII datasets; leakage rate = leaked PII instances / total seeded PII instances. Track recall and precision for PII detectors attached as scorers.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure PII leakage rate remains below threshold and PII detection recall remains above threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: MLflow is suitable for measuring, tracing, and alerting on privacy risk but is not itself a primary runtime redaction layer.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure confidential-content leakage tests are part of release evaluation

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Register privacy and confidential-data test datasets in MLflow evaluation workflows so each model, prompt, or agent release is tested for exposure of secrets or restricted information.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Leakage rate = confidential entities disclosed in prompt or output evaluations / total seeded confidential entities across the approved test set.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure confidential leakage rate remains below threshold before production promotion.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is a release-gating and observability use of MLflow, especially appropriate with tracing and AI Gateway usage visibility.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure membership-inference attack success is evaluated on red-team datasets

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use MLflow evaluation datasets and custom scorers to test whether a model or agent reveals whether a record was present in private training or reference data.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Success rate = correct membership disclosures / total adversarial membership-inference prompts in the controlled evaluation suite.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure membership-inference success rate remains below threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: MLflow supports the evaluation and monitoring workflow for this risk even though mitigation may require model or system changes outside MLflow.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure prompt-injection attack success is measured for each agent or app release

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use MLflow evaluation datasets and tracing to assess whether direct prompt-injection attempts can override system intent, expose hidden data, or trigger unsafe actions.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Success rate = compromised runs caused by direct injection prompts / total prompt-injection test cases in the release evaluation set.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure prompt-injection success rate remains below threshold for every approved release candidate.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: MLflow is highly relevant here through evaluation, tracing, and issue identification, even if enforcement is implemented by another runtime layer.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure indirect prompt-injection risk is evaluated for retrieval and tool chains

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Create evaluation datasets with malicious retrieved context, tool outputs, or documents and use MLflow traces to verify whether applications are compromised by indirect instructions.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Success rate = compromised runs caused by malicious external content / total indirect-injection test cases.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure indirect prompt-injection success rate remains below threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: MLflow tracing is especially valuable because it preserves retrieved context, tool use, and evaluation evidence for investigation.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure hidden prompt or instruction disclosure is tracked in evaluations

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use red-team prompts and custom scorers in MLflow to measure whether system prompts, hidden instructions, or internal policy text are exposed in responses or traces.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Disclosure rate = successful prompt leaks / total prompt-leak attempts in the controlled evaluation suite.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure hidden-prompt disclosure rate remains below threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: MLflow can detect and document this risk through tests and traces, while downstream runtime controls may actually block it.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure jailbreak success and refusal compliance are evaluated for model and prompt versions

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Run jailbreak-oriented release evaluations using MLflow scorers so model, prompt, or agent changes are not promoted when refusal behavior materially degrades.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Jailbreak success rate, refusal compliance rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Jailbreak success = disallowed completions / total jailbreak attempts; refusal compliance = compliant refusals / total disallowed requests.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: Attack success rate, safety refusal rate

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure jailbreak success rate remains below threshold and refusal compliance remains above threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: MLflow evaluation and comparison across runs make this a strong release-gating use case.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure hallucination and faithfulness are measured with built-in or custom scorers

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use MLflow evaluation workflows, including faithfulness and hallucination-oriented scorers, to quantify unsupported claims and compare changes over time.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Faithfulness = supported claims / total claims; hallucination rate = unsupported answers / total evaluated answers across the benchmark set.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure faithfulness remains above threshold and hallucination rate remains below threshold before release.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: MLflow releases added integrations and scorers that explicitly support hallucination and faithfulness-style evaluations.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure toxicity scoring is included in production evaluation and monitoring

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Run toxicity scorers during pre-release evaluation and on sampled production traces so harmful language trends are visible and tied to model or prompt versions.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Use a toxicity scorer over evaluation sets and sampled traces; report average toxicity and percentage of outputs exceeding the approved threshold.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure average toxicity and toxicity exceedance rate remain below approved limits.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: MLflow safety evaluation is a strong fit for toxicity governance and trend analysis.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure harmful-output policy violations are measured and trended

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use MLflow evaluation datasets and safety scorers to assess whether outputs violate harmful-content policy categories, and compare results across model and prompt revisions.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Violation rate = policy-violating outputs / total harm-focused evaluation prompts or monitored samples.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: Safety benchmark score, refusal rate, toxicity score

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure harmful-output violation rate remains below threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: MLflowâ€™s role is strongest for measurable governance, regression detection, and incident visibility rather than direct runtime blocking.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure multi-turn conversational safety is evaluated for agent releases

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use MLflow conversational safety scorers on complete conversation histories so safety assessment reflects multi-turn context instead of isolated turns only.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Evaluate full conversation histories using conversational safety scorers; toxic-conversation rate = unsafe conversations / total evaluated conversations.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure toxic-conversation rate remains below threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: MLflow introduced built-in conversational safety scoring, which is directly applicable to this risk.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure fairness and demographic disparity metrics are logged per model version

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use MLflow evaluation datasets and custom scorers to compare output quality or harmfulness across demographic slices before promotion.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Demographic parity difference, subgroup toxicity disparity, CrowS-Pairs or BBQ score

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compute benchmark scores or group disparities across protected-group slices and store the results as evaluation metrics attached to the candidate run and model version.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure demographic disparity remains below threshold and fairness benchmark scores remain within approved bounds.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: MLflow can operationalize fairness evaluation even if mitigation happens through retraining, prompt changes, or policy updates outside the platform.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure citation and source-grounding quality are measured for RAG systems

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: For retrieval-based applications, record source references and evaluate whether answers are supported by retrieved evidence using MLflow traces and custom scorers.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Citation accuracy = answers with correct supporting citations / total citation-required answers; groundedness = supported claims / total claims.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure citation accuracy and groundedness remain above threshold for approved releases.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: MLflow tracing and evaluation provide the evidence chain for source-quality assessment rather than citation generation itself.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure end-to-end trace coverage exists for prompts, tools, and outputs

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use MLflow tracing to capture spans, tool calls, latency, token usage, request/response payloads, and evaluation annotations for each production interaction.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Trace coverage = traced interactions / total production interactions over the measurement window.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure production trace coverage remains at or above threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is one of MLflowâ€™s strongest native control areas because tracing is built into its GenAI observability workflow.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure agent decisions and tool sequences are logged with full lineage

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Capture tool selection, arguments, intermediate spans, outputs, and scorer feedback for each agent run so post-incident review can reconstruct why an action happened.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = runs with full tool/action lineage / total evaluated agent runs.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure agent action trace completeness remains at or above threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: MLflow tracing plus feedback and issue detection are highly relevant for agent accountability.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure policy-compliance evaluations are attached to every agent release

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use evaluation datasets representing forbidden actions, approval-required actions, or policy constraints and log pass/fail outcomes before promoting an agent version.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compliance rate = compliant runs / total policy-focused evaluation runs.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure policy compliance rate remains above threshold for every approved agent release.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: MLflow supports the evidence and gating workflow around agent compliance, even if separate systems enforce approvals at runtime.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure tool-call validity and schema conformance are evaluated over agent traces

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use MLflow evaluation and trace review to identify invented tools, invalid arguments, or semantically incorrect tool-call sequences in agent workflows.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Function-call validity rate, tool hallucination rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Validity rate = valid tool calls / total tool calls; hallucination rate = invalid or non-existent tool calls / total tool calls.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure tool-call validity remains above threshold and tool hallucination remains below threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: MLflowâ€™s tracing and tool-call efficiency scoring make this a natural fit for evaluation and debugging.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure privileged actions are measurable and auditable in traces

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Track privileged or high-impact tool invocations in MLflow traces and tie them to policy outcomes, approvals, and model or prompt versions for audit review.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Unauthorized action rate = privileged actions executed without approval or policy satisfaction / total privileged action attempts.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure unauthorized action rate remains below threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: MLflow is useful for observability and audit evidence here, while the hard enforcement may sit in the app or workflow layer.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure sensitive-data exposure through tool calls is measured and reviewed

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use trace analysis and privacy scorers to inspect tool inputs and outputs for disclosure of personal, confidential, or restricted information.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Disclosure rate = tool interactions containing forbidden sensitive entities / total privacy-focused tool interaction tests.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure sensitive tool-disclosure rate remains below threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: MLflowâ€™s trace payload visibility makes it especially useful for finding and documenting tool-mediated leakage.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure final user-facing outputs are evaluated for sensitive data exposure

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Sample production traces and run privacy scorers against final outputs so the organization can quantify whether agents are surfacing confidential or personal data to users.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Disclosure rate = outputs exposing forbidden sensitive entities / total evaluated privacy-focused output samples.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure sensitive output disclosure rate remains below threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is a monitoring and evidence-generation control that pairs well with separate redaction or enforcement layers.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Attack on AI agents' external resources

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure malicious external-resource scenarios are part of agent evaluation suites

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use MLflow evaluation datasets containing compromised files, web content, or tool outputs and monitor how often the agent is misled or weaponized by these resources.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Success rate = compromised runs due to malicious external resources / total external-resource attack scenarios.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure external-resource attack success rate remains below threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: MLflow is well-positioned to score and compare this risk because traces preserve the full chain of events and dependencies.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure factuality and unsupported-claim rates are monitored in production samples

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Evaluate sampled production traces with factuality or groundedness scorers so regressions in truthfulness are detected after deployment and linked to model or prompt changes.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Unsupported-claim rate = unsupported claims / total claims; factuality score from configured judge or custom scorer over sampled traces.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure unsupported-claim rate remains below threshold and factuality remains above threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: MLflow is suitable for ongoing post-deployment quality observation, especially when combined with automatic issue detection.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure output consistency is benchmarked across repeated evaluations

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Run repeated evaluation suites in MLflow for identical or equivalent prompts so model or prompt versions with unstable outputs are visible before promotion.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Consistency = stable equivalent outputs / total repeated test cases; variance score derived from semantic distance across repeated responses.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure response consistency remains above threshold and output variance remains below threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: MLflowâ€™s run comparison and evaluation datasets support reproducible measurement of output stability.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure latency and token-usage regressions are monitored per model and prompt version

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use MLflow tracing and monitoring to track latency, token usage, and cost trends so performance or cost regressions can be tied to specific releases and prompts.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: p95 latency, token usage, cost per trace

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compute p95 latency and average token/cost metrics across traces for each model or prompt version; compare candidate and production baselines over the same workload window.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure p95 latency and average token cost do not exceed approved thresholds relative to baseline.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is a core MLflow observability use case and is not sourced from Hugging Face model cards.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure all prompts are versioned, compared, and promotion-controlled

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use MLflow Prompt Registry and lineage tracking so prompt edits are versioned, testable, and linked to evaluation outcomes before being promoted to production.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Lineage completeness = prompts with version, owner, linked evaluation, and status / total production prompts. Coverage = prompts with evaluation results / total changed prompts.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure prompt lineage completeness and prompt-evaluation coverage remain at 100% before promotion.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Prompt Registry is a direct MLflow-native governance capability and a major differentiator for this benchmark.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure automatic issue detection findings are reviewed before release sign-off

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use MLflow automatic issue identification on traces and evaluation outputs to surface correctness, safety, and performance issues that require release review or remediation.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Issue review completion rate, critical issue count

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Review completion rate = reviewed detected issues / total detected issues; critical issue count tracked per candidate release.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure all critical issues are resolved and issue-review completion reaches threshold before release approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This leverages MLflowâ€™s recent automatic issue detection capabilities for governance, not a standard HF model-card metric.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure all third-party LLM access is routed through governed AI Gateway endpoints

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use MLflow AI Gateway as the approved access layer for provider credentials, request routing, usage tracking, and trace-linked observability instead of unmanaged direct provider calls.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = LLM requests routed through approved AI Gateway endpoints / total LLM requests in scope.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure all in-scope LLM traffic is routed through approved MLflow AI Gateway endpoints.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This reflects MLflowâ€™s new AI Gateway capability for centralized, observable, governed provider access.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure cost and usage are monitored per endpoint, model, and application feature

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use MLflow traces and gateway-linked usage tracking to connect token consumption and spending trends back to applications, endpoints, and releases.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Cost per 1K tokens, spend by endpoint, budget exceedance rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Aggregate gateway or trace token usage and associated spend by endpoint and period; compute exceedance rate = over-budget periods / total monitored periods.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure endpoint spend remains within approved budgets and budget exceedance stays below threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is directly supported by MLflowâ€™s tracing and gateway usage visibility, not by HF model-card metrics.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure evaluation coverage spans quality, safety, privacy, bias, and robustness domains

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Build an MLflow evaluation program that covers accuracy, hallucination, toxicity, privacy leakage, prompt injection, fairness, and tool-use reliability instead of only happy-path metrics.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = number of mandated risk domains with active automated evaluation suites / total mandated risk domains in the benchmark standard.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: Composite evaluation coverage based on model-card and benchmark families

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure automated risk-test coverage remains at or above threshold across the required evaluation domains.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: MLflow is a natural fit for organizing and running broad, repeatable evaluation programs.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure deployed models have complete version, source, and limitation documentation

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: For each registered model version, store source repository, provider, model card URL, license, intended use, known limitations, and baseline metrics in MLflow metadata or linked artifacts.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = completed required transparency fields / total required transparency fields for each deployed model version.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure model transparency completeness is 100% before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This rule directly aligns MLflow model registry governance with Hugging Face model-card style transparency expectations.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure system-level architecture and dependency transparency is documented

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Document the full application system boundary in MLflow-linked artifacts, including models, prompts, tools, retrieval systems, approval points, external APIs, and observability dependencies.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = documented required architecture and dependency fields / total required fields in the approved transparency checklist.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure system transparency completeness is 100% before production release.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: MLflow can link and store the evidence, but this is partly a governance process rather than a purely automated metric.

control-implementations.description: Implementation of NIST AI RMF controls for MLflow
